reviews.author: Jordan Turner
reviews.text: I can’t say enough good things about Country Bargain Auto Repair in Statesville! Rick, the owner, is hands down one of the most honest and reliable mechanics I’ve ever come across. From the moment you walk in, he treats you with respect and really takes the time to explain what’s going on with your car without trying to upsell you on anything unnecessary. What really stood out to me is how affordable everything is compared to other shops, especially for the quality of work you get. You can tell Rick genuinely cares about his customers and takes pride in making sure the job is done right the first time. If you’re in or around Statesville and need car work done, this is definitely the place to go. Great service, great prices, and even better people. I won’t be taking my car anywhere else!

reviews.author: Rena Porter
reviews.text: Service was super fast and I was in and I had an excellent experience with this auto repair shop from start to finish. The owner was professional, honest, and incredibly knowledgeable and helpful. The time was faster than expected, and the quality of work was outstanding. Fair pricing, transparent communication, and skilled. I highly recommend this auto repair lot to anyone looking for dependable service.

reviews.author: Nicole Jinkeu
reviews.text: Rick is the best mechanic in the area. Fair price and really kind. I will recommend his shop to my people!

reviews.author: Valerie A. Mills
reviews.text: This is my go to spot for yearly inspection. No appointment is necessary. Rick is always friendly and efficient. Thanks for your kindness!

reviews.author: Beatrice Heard
reviews.text: Honest work and great prices! As someone not from the area not knowing where to go I had a great experience with Mr.Rick! Won’t take my cars anywhere else!

reviews.author: Kosmas Vavoulis
reviews.text: Rick has been doing this for a long time. He usually figures out what the deal is before he hooks up to his high dollar scanner, but he hooks up to it anyway..He does all of My Inspections, most importantly he has morals, he cares about people. Give him a shot, he’s also fair with pricing jobs out.

reviews.author: MeMe
reviews.text: Riiiccckkk nva disappoints me.. I have been coming here for years.. great staff and prices.. Dn let the TRUMP SIGN scare u away.. he’s definitely nothin like the usual supporters.. GREAT GUY.. thank U RICK

reviews.author: Tim Nunn
reviews.text: Rick and his crew were life savers. My Ranger wheel bearing was shot on my way home from Florida to Ohio and they took me right in during their day off. They brought me back into the shop and showed me exactly what was going on.

reviews.author: winn auto
reviews.text: If possible, I'd award more than five stars. Rick breathed a second life into my car with his expertise. The honesty and warmth at this establishment are truly extraordinary. They don't overcharge, offer accurate diagnoses, and ensure you stay informed throughout the process. I highly recommend this place to anyone who deserves proper treatment and excellent service. Thank you once again, Rick, for being an outstanding individual!

reviews.author: Bmore Fan
reviews.text: Absolutely hands down 1000% the best mechanic shop I’ve ever been to in my 37 years of getting cars worked on. Rick is a standup down to earth guy, very genuine not once did he ever try to come for my pockets he was here to help an do the job correctly. If anyone is looking for someone to do work on any type of vehicle Rick at county bargain auto is the place to go. I’ll never go to anyone to get my vehicles worked on. Once again man Rick I appreciate y’all thank y’all so much for everything thanks for doing g one hell of a job taking your time an it’s done right I feel like I’m driving a new truck. Thanks man god bless. One hell of a place!!!!

reviews.author: Jose Vitaliano Mendez
reviews.text: This is absolutely the best auto repair shop in the area. Rick and his staff are truly amazing. My truck broke down. I took it to another shop in town. They told me it would be over $1800 to fix it and his staff repaired my truck for less than $700, it runs great pass North Carolina state inspection with no issues. I highly recommend Rick and his staff very professional and very affordable prices outstanding work he will always have my business. Very highly recommended.

reviews.author: Keith Bills
reviews.text: I've personally went to country bargain for many years. Since it's induction I have been a customer! Rick has always been straight forward on services offered as well as more reasonable than other locations in the area. The owner rick I have witnessed many times help being given because it was the right thing to do. Definitely refer to anyone needing service. Thanks Rick for the service you provide to the community!

reviews.author: Eric Palmeter
reviews.text: Country Bargain Auto Repair is a local business. As we know many services & repairs go very well. Sometimes things strip out or a components need more attention. Rick the owner is a guy that goes above and beyond to make things right. Family member had a random engine oil leak. During an interstate drive. Rick sent a technician over an hour away. They recovered the vehicle and repairs were complete the following day.

reviews.author: Michaela Ayana
reviews.text: Not going to lie, I walked in scared given I don't know much about cars. Rick cleared up all confusions and made me feel like everything was going to be okay. I can't express how grateful and thankful I am for his services! Such an amazing, professional, accurate business. Believe the reviews!!! They're true! I know I can count on Rick if I run into any more issues! Thank you!

reviews.author: Jim Starkey
reviews.text: My car broke down, I needed help on a Saturday when Rick was suppose to be closed. He went out of his way, came to where my car was, and helped me get my car back to his shop. He fixed it right away cause I needed it that day. He gave me a estimate on some other work I needed done. When it was done, he told me it wasn't that bad and charged me less than half of his estimate. He is honest, got the work done right and quickly. I would recommend him.

reviews.author: Jaleil Strickland
reviews.text: Great customer service, very informative, and prices are very reasonable. I wouldn't trust anyone else other than Country Bargain to work on my Caddy. I recommend them for any and ALL of your automotive needs.

reviews.author: Chris Warren
reviews.text: Great guys there! Definitely want to recognize Rick the owner for talk this time to help us on the side of the road, on a Saturday afternoon! He wasn’t even open, but when we called and asked if he could help us , he was there within no time!! He came and got our wheel and tire off of the vehicle repaired it , put it back on the vehicle and absolutely would not take any money from us! We were blessed to have met him in our travels today!!

reviews.author: Erskine Morrison
reviews.text: It has been a few months since I last came here, but I have come here for the last few years for both my vehicles and my husband's. The shop may not be pristine, like you'd see as a dealership service shop, but they sure are way better as far as time waiting, price, AND customer service. I actually was able to have a conversation with them, and information I wasn't knowledgeable on, they were able to look it up. If I didn't understand what they were really talking about regarding issues with my vehicles, they explained it in detail and it allowed me to learn things about cars and trucks that I was clueless on. (I'm a lady who only knows basic things about cars). I never felt as if they were trying to pull a fast one, or claim there were other issues with my vehicle just to rack a bill up. I never felt that they really didn't care, or didn't know their a$$ from a hole in the ground. I felt like they were true to the trade, their skills, their prices, and their customers. I have always left satisfied and if I'm financially able at the time, I will tip them good. You won't leave disappointed taking your vehicle here. I promise you that.

reviews.author: Albertena Peacock
reviews.text: On Friday I was out with my family and noticed that my break and tail light was out in the rain. I stopped by Country Bargain a little after 5, spoke with a gentleman. He went back into the shop, washed his hands and came back and fixed my problem. The blessing that came was he said to me have a nice day! I truly thank Rick for the A rating customer service that he gave, and praise God for allowing him to be a blessing to me. He is a fair man of integrity which is hard to find this day in time.

reviews.author: Lindsey Newsum
reviews.text: What an amazing experience from Rick (owner) and his team gave my fiancé and I with replacing the radiator in our car. Professional and was able to schedule us when we really needed it. This is the only place I will go for our car needs! Thank you Rick!

reviews.author: Katie Nunn
reviews.text: Got stranded on the way back home from vacation and these guys fixed our truck even though they were supposed to be closed (it's Saturday)! They even let our dog sit inside with us since it was so cold!!!

reviews.author: Jon Moore
reviews.text: I have been using country bargain for years. They have always fixed my vehicle right and have been cheaper on repairs than most. They also stand behind there work. If you are looking for a good honest mechanic,look no further. This is the place to take your vehicles just ask for Rick .. he is Mechanical genius!!!

reviews.author: Laura Camby
reviews.text: If you are in need of car care this is the place. I highly recommend this shop for trusted service work to be completed fairly and efficiently. This business consistently provides excellent services and Rick is super nice!

reviews.author: Steve Siesser
reviews.text: It was a holiday weekend and I was passing through NC on my way home to Florida. I called Rick and he was at the shop, even though it was closed. He told me to come in and he spent several hours diagnosing the problem. He was very thorough and even though he couldn't get the correct parts, came up with a temporary fix to get me home. He knows his stuff and I highly recommend him.

reviews.author: ATLAS Creations
reviews.text: Amazing service and amazing people I went in for an issue with my brakes not knowing the cost. The owner a real stand up Man got me right and on my way. I sincerely thank you Kirt. Thank you

reviews.author: Qi Fleming
reviews.text: Rick and his team are so professional, understanding and reasonably priced! They work in all of my vehicles and I can say I have always been more than satisfied!!!!

reviews.author: Joel Pace
reviews.text: Friendly, fast and honest! Rick is the real deal! Hard working man that works hard to help you. Old school.....love seeing it survive instead of big box junk. You'll appreciate having him in your corner.

reviews.author: Robert Crews
reviews.text: Rick did perform the listed issues with my vehicle; however he stated I needed a transmission & in fact on my way back to Ohio my vehicle broke down; I wish he was infactic telling me to not drive back Ohio with the money I spent with him.

reviews.author: Natalie Beaman
reviews.text: These people are CROOKS!!!! I’ve been taken advantage by a mechanic before but never like this. They over charged me for parts & labor & I paid for services they never performed. I spoke to the owner he assured me he got rid of the problem staff and I went in today because the “New “ alternator I paid them for went out 3 month later come to find out autozone said they returned the one I bought so who knows where they got the one in my car & they charged me $40 more than what they paid for the one the returned. That’s just one of the MANY problems with this shop. If you are considering taking your car there DON’T DO IT!!!!!

reviews.author: Daniel bills
reviews.text: Rick and his team are very professional. They are prompt with their work and very affordable. I have used them for several years and will continue to do so in the future.

reviews.author: Crystal Schultz
reviews.text: Owner Rick and crew are fantastic! Great customer service. I'd highly recommend stopping in if you need help with your vehicle.

reviews.author: Salem's Greatest Hits Collection
reviews.text: I took my car to be fixed last year. Was told it was a boot. Paid around $270 to have a boot fix. Got it back, it was still broke. Still popping and cracking. They wrote on receipt that i needed tie rods fixed. So this year took it back and they said it was tie rods broke. Next day called and said struts broke, not tie rods. I said "what?" Anyway I agree to let them fix struts. Call me back after we agree on a price and say it needs mounts. I said forget it. What have you done to my car? They fixed windshields arm charged $170 and didn't even replace windshield wipers or no parts. Then got car back. Underneathe is worse broke. Called man today. Tried to be nice to him. He hollared at me and hung up on me. I would not let them fix a bicycle of mine. They Dont know a Strut from a Tie rod, will rip you off and break your car worse...then yell at you and hang up on you. Awful place

reviews.author: Don channel
reviews.text: My fiancée went over there to get some work on her car. They did it but half did it. She spent $130 to get it work on but I felt due to she was a female they didn't take it seriously. I heard from other people they didn't do a good job and had to tell them to work on it again or they tried to get a refund. I don't know why she went there no disrespect to the place but she should had been patient and took it to Alray where she usually goes.

reviews.author: Amy Redmon
reviews.text: I love this place, Rick always sees to my needs with my vehicles and takes his time. Genuine customer service!

reviews.author: natalie oliveras
reviews.text: Great service . Rick was super helpful & provided speedy service . He helped my husband get back on the road . Thanks Rick . We will definitely be coming back .

reviews.author: Chadrick McGee
reviews.text: Great people. Fast service,they go to great lengths to accommodate the customer needs. I highly recommend them they are truly a 1 stop shop.

reviews.author: Tanya Lackey
reviews.text: Went on a day that they were closed. Never had been there before. He did my service for me anyway. Rick is a stand up guy. Thanks

reviews.author: Dixie Kneale
reviews.text: They squeezed me in on a Saturday and got my starter replaced in about an hour. Super fast, and great service!

reviews.author: Mike Schreffler
reviews.text: The people here were amazing! Helped my family and I get back on the road after we had car troubles going back to Ohio from Hilton Head. You don't find many people or places like this anymore!

reviews.author: Courtney Newsome
reviews.text: Best costumer service and fair pricing! They don’t rip you off ! Quick turn around will do what they can to help :)

reviews.author: Marie Stout
reviews.text: I love the folks here especially Moose. They are all so kind, understanding and explain the problems and how to resolve them the best way possible and at a fair price. Would highly recommend them.

reviews.author: Raeshaun Brown
reviews.text: I needed a code reprogrammed & Rick helped me & was respectful about about. I appreciate the help & I will be back if anything else needs repairing on my vehicle.

reviews.author: Leon Mitchell
reviews.text: Country Bargain always does an outstanding job on my vechicles. Fair pricing and outstanding service. Wouldn’t take my vechicles anywhere else.

reviews.author: Jodie Collins
reviews.text: I broke down on the interstate on y way to VA and they came to me and fixed it and was very very affordable. God bless them

reviews.author: Doc Hemmi
reviews.text: Fair pricing. Can drop off after hours which is good for work schedules. Parts are warrantied. Professional staff!

reviews.author: Shanda Ostwalt
reviews.text: Always a great experience, talented with respect and employees do an amazing job!!! Customer service is 100% amazing!!! Will definitely go back!!

reviews.author: LaMona Coastin
reviews.text: I came in without an appointment and I was greeted by friendly staff. They quickly changed the oil and also did my state inspection. I will be back again!

reviews.author: Shaketta Williams
reviews.text: I had a nail in my tire and they were the only shop on this street that would help.. fast, efficient and kind!! Will absolutely recommend

reviews.author: B Mcc
reviews.text: This is the only place I go for repairs. Fast, friendly,and very reasonable rates. They work on anything from classic to today's American and foreign.

reviews.author: Danny Hogue
reviews.text: These people are reasonable and most of all they are courteous and friendly. They make things right.

reviews.author: Nick Hinton
reviews.text: I was driving down from Asheville and had the panel on the bottom of my car fall down. Rick took me in as a walk in and even fixed my oil pan sensor that the last mechanic who worked on the car messed up. I would consider the 1.5 hour drive just to have Rick work on my car. Good honest mechanic.
